description: Use this when someone asks to add a new animal to their vet clinic, such as a new puppy of an existing owner. Returns the animal's id, name and clinic; it is saved with its species, breed and owner. Not for adding a pet owner.

breed.description: The breed, when the user gives one.

clientId.description: Id of the animal's owner at this clinic, from find_client or create_client.

clinicId.description: Id of the clinic, from list_clinics. Leave it out when the user has one clinic.

requestId.description: A unique id you choose for this animal, such as a UUID. Calling again with the same requestId returns the first animal rather than adding a second one.

species.description: The species: dog, cat, rodent, bird, reptile, horse, livestock or other.

name: create_patient
title: Add an animal
